info.title: Hello pack
info.description: The routes of the SDK's example pack. The console mounts every path below under /api/v1/x/hello/.

get.summary: Read the greeting and the name of the caller

200.description: The greeting document's text and the caller's label.

caller.description: The label of the console user or token making the request, or "unknown".

502.description: The greeting document could not be read.

503.description: The worker is not connected to the console yet.
